_notes.source: Names, prices, descriptions, categories and order synced from the official online menu at eatnatraj.com on 2026-09-04 (151 items). Dietary prefixes in the official descriptions were moved into tags; 'served with rice/raita' lines live in the category blurbs.
_notes.img: Not a file path. A 'visual family' key: o-<id> is the official photo from eatnatraj.com for that dish; other keys are shared Pexels families for dishes without an official photo. scripts/fetch-images.mjs pulls Pexels families into /public/dishes/<family>.jpg.
